meta.author: Śrīla Bhakti Rakṣak Śrīdhar Dev-Goswāmī Mahārāj

title: Bhagavān Śrīla Bhakti Siddhānta Saraswatī Ṭhākur

text: bhāto bhānur iva prabhāta-gagane yo gaura-saṅkīrtanaiḥ
translation: In the great Gauḍīya Vaiṣṇava teachers’ line,\
as Śrīla Bhakti Siddhānta Saraswatī he’s renowned.\
Like the radiant sun in the morning sky,\
he appeared to rescue all souls swallowed by\
By spreading the teachings of Lord Gaurāṅga\
to sing the Holy Name of Lord Śrī Kṛṣṇa,\
he gave all the chance to dive in the ocean\
of love of Śrī Kṛṣṇa, the Supreme Person.\
Śrīla Bhakti Siddhānta, my lord, divine master – \
at his feet do I pray to serve him forever.
